status: proposal; no reranker implementation or gain claim
motivation: The constructor has60s available; the current analytic W selector uses about1.4s. Direct finite-strength density evaluation could capture mixed noise and X penalties that the expansion omits.
timing_evidence: Completed PORT016 probes take about0.5s per distinctN8circuit/model and10.5s perN10circuit/model with4detuning draws, including current score sampling overhead.

proposal.N8: Use the analytic16-tree shortlist, retain baseline plus at most3finalists, evaluate6-8 frozen scenarios directly; estimated12-16s plus screening.
proposal.N10: Baseline plus one finalist,3 scenarios with2detuning draws each; estimated31.5s plus screening. Soft deadline near45s and retain baseline unless comparison is complete.
proposal.objective: Evaluate actual finite-shot E[1/penalty] with fixed common random numbers or a separately validated deterministic approximation. Do not rank inverse mean penalty as E[score].
proposal.noise: Scenario choices must be fixed before new-seed results; include nominal, coherent and heterogeneousZZ risks. These remain assumed models, not measured hardware.

acceptance: Measure full constructor walltime below60s on representative cases.
Return only exact native W circuits; all other main/bonus paths unchanged.
Freeze scenario/MCseeds independently of evaluation seeds and report winner-selection uncertainty.
Require fresh paired evaluation after algorithm freeze; compare against both current baseline and PORT016 selector.
risk: Timing estimates are empirical and cannot guarantee runtime under external contention; deadline checks must happen before beginning expensive optional work. Direct modeled optimization can still overfit incorrect hardware assumptions.
